data.why: Arka grew headcount by 70% to over 1,200 employees over the last year, which creates operational back-office strain. The recent funding round was covered across multiple press outlets with conflicting dollar amounts, making headcount growth the cleaner and less saturated hook.
data.angle: Rapid headcount expansion multiplies vendor invoices and purchase approvals faster than the finance back office can process them.

not_chosen.reason: Covered across several media outlets so every SDR will lead with it, plus reported figures conflict across sources ($56M vs $85M vs ₹525 crore).
She stepped into the CFO role over 600 days ago, making it stale, and cold emails shouldn't tell prospects about their own job history.
Past employment at Bandhan AMC is biographical background, not a current operational trigger.
Historical career experience at PwC dating back over a decade provides no reason to buy software today.
A general stock market news roundup mentioning unrelated public companies.

data.subject: 70% headcount growth
data.body:
Hi Ridhi,

Arka grew its team by 70% in the last twelve months to over 1,200 people.

Growing that fast usually means bills and purchase approvals multiply much faster than finance can keep up. Who is checking all those new vendor invoices today?

Instacart cut its AP approval time from two weeks to two days with Zamp.

Worth a look?

[Your name]
